name: Boxed Figure
tagline: Shrink into a collectible action figure sealed in its box.
subject: the person
endFrame: Turn {subject} into a glossy plastic collectible action figure sealed inside a retail blister package: a clear plastic bubble over a colourful cardboard backing with bold graphic shapes and a hanging tab, small accessories in moulded slots beside the figure. The figure keeps {subject}'s outfit, hairstyle and pose with visible toy joints and painted details. No brand names or logos.
motion: {subject} shrinks and stiffens as their skin takes on a smooth painted-plastic sheen and visible toy joints appear at the shoulders and knees. A clear plastic blister shell snaps closed around them and a bright cardboard backing slides in behind, sealing them in the package. The camera pulls back slightly to reveal the whole box.
sound: a playful plastic clicking, a whoosh, and a satisfying blister-pack snap
author: Conjure
